degree.text: Degree Awarded: Bachelor’s Degree in Management"

description.text: "This program is to cultivate students to master basic theory and knowledge of tourism management subjects, know the development in tourism, aquire the ability of analyzing and settling problems by utilizing tourism management theory and be qualified for careers in tourism administration departments at all leves, tourism enterprizes and tourism institutions. Major Courses: Management, Micro-economics, Macro-economics, Accounting, Management Information System, Statistics, Financial Management, Marketing Management, Economic Law, Brief Introduction of Tourism, Tourism Economics, Hotel Management Principle, Tourism Resources and Their Development, etc. Degree Awarded: Bachelor’s Degree in Management"

duration.text: The Tourism Management at Beijing International Studies University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 3.Academic transcript of high school 4.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above 5.Photocopy of valid passport or residence permit With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 6.Resume Written in Chinese or in English

requirements.text: 1.In the age bracket of 18-50 2.Be in good health 3.Holding senior high school graduation diploma at least 4.Holding certificate of HSK Level 6 or above 5.Passing the major test and oral Chinese interview held by the applied department
